Screenshots: `<scratchpad>/pass3/ios/NN-*.png` (scratchpad = `/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-work-Ordering-ordering-app-business-theming/3f70efc6-0154-439f-b577-4c786cf37ae6/scratchpad`); every one opened and looked at. No tablet, no Android and no iPhone rotation here: the tablet items are fixed in code and tests and **were not seen on a device**.

Verdicts: **fixed** (cause in a line, files, how it was seen) / **not a defect** / **could not fix**.

## 7. Why the assign-driver list is empty

**The data, not the app.** The sheet asks `GET controls/orders/:id` (`OrderActions/useDrivers.ts`), and `ControlsController::order` (api-core) lists the drivers of the enabled driver groups linked to the order's business (`driver_group_business`) whose users are enabled. Read with the test account: `controls/orders/2805` answers `drivers: []`; the local project has 797 driver users, but no driver group has business 73 (the store of #2805, "Domino's Pizza"); group 1 has businesses 3 and 41 and drivers 6 and 13217, and the sheet for #3344 (store 41) lists "Driver D." and "Driver QA i." (`47-assign-list.png`). Nothing is wrong in the request or a filter. What was wrong: the empty sheet read "Without drivers" plus an "Unassign driver" button that nothing could press, and with drivers listed and none chosen the button also read "Unassign driver" (disabled) for an order with no driver. Now: the one `NotFoundSource` ("No drivers for this store yet", "Drivers appear here once the store belongs to a driver group.", no button; seen `46`), and "Assign driver" (disabled) until a choice; "Unassign driver" only when the order has a driver (`OrderActions/AssignDriverSheet.tsx`, tests in `OtherSheets.test.tsx`).

## From `tablet-android-pass2.md` (not seen on a device)

| # | Verdict | What |
|---|---|---|
| 11 TAB2-C1 two clocks | **fixed** | The card counted from `reporting_data.at['status:7']` (to the second), the details from the history's stamp (to the minute, moved by a learned offset). `OrderDetails/orderTimes.ts` `statusMoments.at` takes the report first: one instant. Test: `orderTimes.test.ts` (details' `prepClock` and the card's `orderClock` give the same remaining time) |
| 12 TAB2-C5 Printers, none, landscape | **fixed** | The list pane shows the one empty state ("No printers yet", the hint, the PDF line) instead of the auto-print switch of nothing; no add button beside the wizard that is already the way to add one (`PrinterSettings/index.tsx`, `PrinterSettings.test.tsx`) |
| 13 The counts | **partly possible** | The controller gives `ordersGroup.active.pagination.total` (the server's total of **all** open orders, kept +1/-1 by its own handlers): the Active tab of the combined layout now reads that (`99+` capped by `countText`, no "+"). **Not exposed:** a total for New alone and for In progress alone. The controller holds a slot per group (`pending`, `inProgress`) with their own `pagination.total`, but `loadOrders` fetches only the selected tab's slot, so those totals stay `null`; the app uses the one `active` slot and splits it on the client, so New / In progress / the Orders badge / the board's columns are lower bounds ("21+" on the phone, "59+" on the rail) while pages remain. The local API says New is **544** (`orders?where status [0,13]`, `pagination.total`). What is missing in the submodule (additive): a call that asks each group's total without its orders (`page_size=1` per group, stored in `ordersGroup[group].pagination.total`), or a total per group in the `active` answer. Not changed (rule). `useOrdersSplit.ts`, test "the Active tab counts the server's total" |

## New findings

- **B (the Messages list is stale after an app action):** after "Picked up" on #2988 the Messages tab still said "Ready for pickup" (`28`); the list does not listen to `ORDER_CHANGED_EVENT` (`PreviousMessages`).
- **C:** the details of a ready pickup draw a "Subtotal" row above "Total" with the same amount; the mockup draws "Total" alone (`12`). The header search button, tonal when a filter is on, runs 11 pt past the page gutter (`02`). Status names are the server's words in lists and pills ("Order picked up completed by customer", "Order status accepted by restaurant"; the mockup says "Picked up by customer"); one wording is the harmony record's H4, not done here. The printers' empty hint text is 382 wide from x 10, past the gutter (`33`).
- **Process:** the app reloaded each time a file of this round was saved (as the testers' do); once the React Native element inspector opened itself while text was typed outside a field (`39`), the app was relaunched.

## What I changed in the local data

Signed in to the local API with the test account to read (one more session of the account; nothing written through it). On the device, three old pending pickup orders accepted from their cards, 20 min: **#2988**, **#3113**, **#3114**. Marked ready: #2988 and #3113 (as allowed), and **#3344** (a delivery of store 41 that was accepted earlier by the second pass) **by a mis-tap** on the details' footer while I meant to close a sheet: that is a third "ready", over the budget; it cannot be undone from the app. #2988 completed ("Picked up"); #3113 "Not picked up" (confirmed); #3114 adjusted +5 minutes (stays accepted). A generic printer "Kitchen" was added and removed (the list is empty again). Opened #4471's chat (marks its messages read) and a review (nothing sent). Nothing rejected, no store or product changed, no driver assigned, sound settings not touched.
